### 💡 Is your feature request related to a problem? Please describe.
A clear and concise description of what the problem or missing feature is. (e.g. I want to monitor token usage from Ollama / DeepSeek / Cursor).

### ✨ Describe the solution you'd like
A clear and concise description of what you want to happen and how the feature should work.

### 🔍 Describe alternatives you've considered
A clear and concise description of any alternative solutions or features you've considered.

### 🎨 Mockups / Screenshots
If applicable, add screenshots or diagrams to help explain your idea.

### 📌 Additional Context
Add any other context or references about the feature request here.
